description.narrative:
Overall Objective (Impact): Sustainable and inclusive economic growth in Palestine, driven by diversified livelihoods, increased incomes for individuals and companies, particularly youth and women, and a stronger, more competitive tech sector.
Intermediate Objective: Palestinian individuals and companies have strengthened and diversified livelihoods and increased income through online/digital engagement with international markets.
Immediate Objectives: 1. Palestinian individuals and companies demonstrate improved knowledge and skills leading to increased readiness for employment and market engagement. 2. Palestinian individuals and companies enhanced exposure and access to international market.

The programme builds on the successful Gaza Sky Geeks (GSG) initiative originally launched in 2011 through a partnership between Mercy Corps and Google to foster digital entrepreneurship in Gaza. Sweden supported the expansion of GSG initiative into Gaza and the West Bank through the six-year “Developing the Technology Ecosystem in Palestine” programme (2019–2025, 63 MSEK). The programme helped thousands of Palestinians, particularly youth and women, earn sustainable income through digital work through coding and freelancing education, start-ups acceleration, and employability trainings. Building on lessons learned, this new phase, TechRise Palestine, will further scale GSG's impact with greater focus on the West Bank, with flexibility to re-engage in Gaza when conditions allow, to foster inclusive, tech-enabled economic growth and resilience. It takes a systemic market development approach, strengthening both the supply (digital talent, tech SMEs) and demand sides (market linkages, corporate partnerships) of the digital economy, leveraging partnerships with major tech companies, universities, and private sector actors to institutionalise quality training and expand high-value digital specialisations. The programme will equip around 3,500 young Palestinians with specialised tech and employability skills and support 45 Palestinian tech firms to innovate, scale, and access international markets. In doing so, the programme contributes to women’s economic empowerment, youth employment, and a globally connected Palestinian digital economy. The programme contributes to Team Europe Initiative on Sustainable Growth, Jobs and Resilience in Palestine – Digital economy component.

tag.narrative: 1.4 - By 2030, ensure that all men and women, in particular the poor and the vulnerable, have equal rights to economic resources, as well as access to basic services, ownership and control over land and other forms of property, inheritance, natural resources, appropriate new technology and financial services, including microfinance.

1.4 - Senast 2030 säkerställa att alla män och kvinnor, i synnerhet de fattiga och de utsatta, har lika rätt till ekonomiska resurser, tillgång till grundläggande tjänster, möjlighet att äga och kontrollera mark och andra former av egendom samt tillgång till arv, naturresurser, lämplig ny teknik och finansiella tjänster, inklusive mikrokrediter.
4.4 - By 2030, substantially increase the number of youth and adults who have relevant skills, including technical and vocational skills, for employment, decent jobs and entrepreneurship.

4.4 - Till 2030 väsentligen öka det antal ungdomar och vuxna som har relevanta färdigheter, däribland tekniska färdigheter och yrkeskunnande, för sysselsättning, anständigt arbete och entreprenörskap.
5.b - Enhance the use of enabling technology, in particular information and communications technology, to promote the empowerment of women.
5.b - Öka användningen av gynnsam teknik, i synnerhet informations- och kommunikationsteknik, för att främja kvinnors egenmakt

8.3 - Främja utvecklingsinriktad politik som stöder produktiv verksamhet, skapande av anständiga arbetstillfällen, företagande, kreativitet och innovation samt uppmuntra att mikroföretag liksom små och medelstora företag växer och blir en del av den formella ekonomin, bland annat genom tillgång till finansiella tjänster.

8.3 - Promote development-oriented policies that support productive activities, decent job creation, entrepreneurship, creativity and innovation, and encourage the formalization and growth of micro-, small- and medium-sized enterprises, including through access to financial services.
